partyMembers.name: Zane Vale
partyMembers.bio: A rare Resonant who hears the pain inside corrupted Guardians instead of only sensing their rage.
partyMembers.storyHook: Zane is the proof that the old war was not won cleanly. His gift makes every battlefield a testimony and every spared Guardian a witness.

partyMembers.name: Mira Vey
partyMembers.bio: A practical medic who trusts bandages, field notes, and proof more than prophecy.
partyMembers.storyHook: Mira turns skepticism into resistance. She records what power wants treated as rumor, hysteria, or battlefield fog.

partyMembers.name: Captain Rusk
partyMembers.bio: Ashvale's watch captain. He does not understand Resonance, but he understands standing between danger and civilians.
partyMembers.storyHook: Rusk embodies the necessary danger of order: walls save people, but walls can also hide the crime that guarantees the next war.
